description:
LWK Premium Collection are delighted to introduce No. 13 Cremorne, Greenmount Road, Terenure to the market.

Nestled within the highly regarded Cremorne development, this superb two-bedroom home enjoys a peaceful and private setting just off Greenmount Road, in the heart of ever-popular Terenure.

One of the standout features of No. 13 is its wonderful south-facing aspect overlooking the beautifully maintained landscaped grounds of Cremorne. This attractive outlook provides a lovely sense of space, light and privacy, with the property enjoying a tranquil setting.Extensively upgraded in recent years, the property is presented in excellent condition throughout and combines generous proportions with a stylish, contemporary feel. Improvements include PVC double-glazed windows, new flooring, gas-fired central heating, a modern fully fitted kitchen and a beautifully appointed contemporary bathroom.

The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hall, separate modern fully fitted kitchen, generous living/dining room overlooking the beautifully landscaped grounds, contemporary fully tiled bathroom and two well-proportioned double bedrooms, both with built-in wardrobes.The living/dining room is a particularly appealing space, enjoying excellent natural light and a wonderful outlook over the mature grounds of Cremorne. The combination of the south-facing aspect, generous accommodation and peaceful setting creates a home that is both comfortable and exceptionally easy to enjoy.

The location is excellent. Cremorne is ideally positioned within easy walking distance of Terenure Village and Rathgar Village, offering an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, shops and everyday amenities. Bushy Park is also within pleasant walking distance, providing extensive recreational facilities, while the M50 is readily accessible. Numerous bus routes provide convenient access to Dublin city centre and surrounding areas.

No. 13 Cremorne is an ideal home for a wide range of purchasers, including first-time buyers, downsizers and investors seeking a quality property in a prime South Dublin location. The combination of its south-facing aspect, peaceful landscaped setting, excellent condition, generous proportions and superb Terenure location makes this a particularly attractive opportunity.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, space, light and exceptional setting of this wonderful home.
